text: PR #5425 (#5421, migrate workspace_agent_process_parser.cpp to the atomic check-and-open primitive) merged as 0c1b544c5 after 4 adversarial review rounds. Round 1: reviewer-caught (not self-caught, unlike #5420's round 1) real security regression -- the migration dropped the effective post-read link_count re-check the old string-based read got 'for free' via full operator==, because the new primitive's content_equal() freshness check deliberately excludes link_count (per #5420 round 4); a hard link added to the trusted executable during the read window would go undetected in both capture_binding() and authorize_windows(). Fixed via a shared read_trusted_executable_snapshot() helper that re-checks the fresh post-read identity's link_count != 1 before either caller trusts snapshot.ok. Also corrected a CHANGELOG line overclaiming an existing test covered the removed is_regular_file() precheck. Round 2: no dedicated regression test existed for the round-1 fix and it was duplicated logic; added a macro-gated COPPERFIN_ENABLE_WORKSPACE_AGENT_PROCESS_PARSER_TEST_HOOKS test hook (matching the PR #5416 precedent) plus test_capture_binding_rejects_hard_link_added_during_read(), verified absent from production builds via -DCOPPERFIN_BUILD_TESTS=OFF + nm grep. Round 3: the new test hard-failed the whole suite on filesystems without hard-link support instead of gracefully skipping like the file's own pre-existing convention; fixed to match. Round 4: judged unnecessary (test-only, mechanical, matching an established pattern exactly) -- confirmed correct when a stale/already-fixed codex-bot review thread from an earlier round was the only merge blocker (required_review_thread_resolution rule), resolved by reply-and-resolve rather than any further code change. Issue #5421 closed. Starting #5422 now (workspace_agent_target_containment.cpp's one check-then-read pair) per standing pre-authorization -- first verifying by reading the actual code whether the same link_count post-read gap applies there before assuming the pattern transfers directly.
